headline: Sensex gains 200 points at pre-open as Nifty tops 25,300; Asian markets decline

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex gained 200 points in pre-open trade while Nifty crossed 25,300.
Nomura upgraded ABB India to Neutral citing growth opportunities in electrification and data centres.
Bernstein issued strong upside potential for food delivery sector while flagging margin risks.
Asian markets traded lower amidst global updates.
whatHappening: ABB India saw brokerages highlighting growth prospects from data centres and electrification.
Bernstein compared Swiggy and Zomato, projecting up to 84% upside in one stock.
Sensex rose 200 points in early action while Nifty topped the 25,300 mark.
IMD warned of heavy rains and strong winds due to approaching Cyclone Akvan.
